**Congratulations Dr. Peruma!.** Congratulations Dr. Peruma for successfully defending your Ph.D. thesis! You kept your advisor Christian and your collaborators busy throughout the past 5 years! **Multiple Publications Accepted At MSR 2022.** We are pleased to announce that we have multiple papers accepted at MSR 2022. The accepted papers include one full research paper and two mining challenge papers.
**Best Mining Challenge Paper Award.** We are pleased to announce that our Mining Challenge paper has won the best paper award!!!
